# K2.3 LM head forward in MXFP8

Classification: Internal (becomes public with the MLPerf Training v6.1 results)

[Index](../KERNELS.md) · Class: **Precision** · Rule basis: numerical formats (TR-5.2a; MXFP8 as in K2.2); no
trainable parameter added (TR-5.2b).

## 1. Packages

G3, G6 and G6b, where named below, are Firmus's earlier GPT-OSS NVFP4 packages (`nemo_g3_nvfp4_v1`, `nemo_g6_nvfp4_v2`,
`nemo_g6b_nvfp4_v2_1`), withdrawn from this submission and no longer in this repository. Their values, line numbers,
images and test jobs are cited as the record of where evidence was collected ([Index](../KERNELS.md), "Earlier packages").

- `NVFP4_LMHEAD_MXFP8=1` (config line 117),
  `NVFP4_LMHEAD_MXFP8_MODE=fprop` (line 118).
  `NVFP4_LMHEAD_MXFP8_FORMAT` is not set (default `e4m3`).
- Same values in G3, G6 and G6b. Code: `nvfp4_lmhead_mxfp8.py` from `transformer_engine_firmus_nvfp4.patch`
  (identical patch file) and the install hook in `pretrain.py` (G3 L91–96, G6 and G6b L104–109, G6c L121–126, same text).

## 2. What the reference does

The output layer is a Megatron `ColumnParallelLinear` (TP 1, no bias) with its own weight: the model config sets
`share_embeddings_and_output_weights=False` and `vocab_size=128256` (`pretrain.py`
L1081–1082), so the weight
is 128256 × 2880. Its forward, dgrad and wgrad GEMMs run in BF16; `gradient_accumulation_fusion` is on (`gaf=True`
in the run log).

## 3. What this implementation does

1. `install()` (patch L221–240) wraps `GPTModel.__init__`; on the post-process stage, if the output layer exists and is
   not shared with the embedding (L230), it calls `patch_output_layer` and rank 0 prints the line of Check
   (L232–238).
2. `patch_output_layer` (L145–218) builds a TE `Linear` on the meta device and sets its `weight` to the layer's own
   Parameter (L158–166). The helper is attached with `object.__setattr__` (L216), so it is not a registered
   submodule: parameter list, state-dict keys, optimizer and DDP buffers are unchanged.
3. Mode `fprop` (L200–201): `_Fprop.forward` (L183–185) runs the helper under `fp8_autocast(MXFP8BlockScaling(E4M3))`
   (`_mx`, L177–179). `_Fprop.backward` (L188–193) computes `dx = dy @ w` and `dw = dyᵀ @ x` as BF16 matmuls and
   returns `dw` as the gradient of the layer weight.

## 4. Why this is allowed / what changes

Not an equivalence: the logits come from an MXFP8 GEMM instead of BF16. The backward stays BF16, so the gradients
reaching the model are BF16 GEMMs of the same operands. `mxfp8` is not named in the rule's pre-approved list
(TR-5.2a). MXFP8 stores FP8 E4M3 values with an E8M0 power-of-two scale per 32 elements; the log records it as
`fp8`, as NVIDIA's recipe does (see K2.2 Section 4). **Class: Precision.**

## 5. Numerics

Forward: E4M3 operands with an E8M0 scale per 32 elements, FP32 accumulation, BF16 logits. Backward: BF16 operands,
FP32 accumulation in cuBLAS, BF16 `dx` and `dw`. Measured logits error vs FP64: 3.77e-2 relative L2 (BF16: 1.66e-3).

## 6. Shapes and fallbacks

- **Gate:** TP 1 without sequence parallel, no bias, both weight dimensions divisible by 32 (L149–154); mode one of
  `full`, `fprop`, `fwd`, `bwd` (L173–175); no runtime weight other than the layer's (L196–197). TE's MXFP8 cast
  additionally needs the token count divisible by 8 (the test's 4095 / 4097 / 24575 / 24577 tokens raise).
- **Falls back:** none; every gate failure raises `RuntimeError` at model build or first call. One silent case: with
  shared embedding and output weights the layer is not patched and no line is printed (L230), so the absence of
  the line is the signal.
- **Assumes:** (a) the BF16 `dw` returned through autograd reaches the main gradient as the upstream wgrad does. With
  `gaf=True` upstream Megatron writes the wgrad into `main_grad`; here `weight.grad` is set and `main_grad` is not
  written by the layer (test), so the accumulation into `main_grad` is left to Megatron's DDP gradient hook. The
  gradient buffer is BF16 (`grad_reduce_in_fp32=False`), so both paths round the wgrad to BF16 once; their GEMM
  kernels can differ in summation order. This path through Megatron's hook was not tested (the test's reference is
  `F.linear`). (b) The token count per micro-batch (3 × 8192 = 24,576) stays divisible by 8.
- **Check:** every scored `result_*.txt` (all 10 runs) has
  `NVFP4 LM head MXFP8 (e4m3, mode=fprop) weight (128256, 2880) gaf=True`.

## 7. Code

- `transformer_engine_firmus_nvfp4.patch` → `transformer_engine/pytorch/ops/basic/nvfp4_lmhead_mxfp8.py` (patch
  L116–240): `_recipe` L140–142, `patch_output_layer` L145–218 (`_Fprop` L181–193, `forward` L195–214), `install`
  L221–240.
- `pretrain.py`: L121–126.

## 8. Tests and evidence

**Kernel test `k2_3_lmhead`** (runs the L3 test `k11_lmhead.py` on the installed TE module; reference
`F.linear` in BF16 and FP64; MXFP8 vs BF16 errors are records, so "cases with a difference" counts only compares).
- Job 22894 (this package's image): 7 cases, 0 with a difference, 4 recorded errors per run (4095, 4097, 24575 and
  24577 tokens: TE raises, leading dimensions not divisible by 8). Run a vs b: 15 digests equal.
- Values (G6 image, jobs 22229 and 22398): logits MXFP8 vs BF16 rel L2 0.0377 (max abs 0.254) at 24,576 tokens; vs
  FP64 MXFP8 0.0377, BF16 0.00166; outliers 0.0378, wide rows 0.0380, 32 tokens 0.0377. Captured `output_layer`
  input of a G6 run (22398): MXFP8 vs FP64 3.78e-2, BF16 1.66e-3. `dx` and `dw`: 0 differing elements against BF16
  in every case. Helper weight is the layer's Parameter (same data pointer, not a submodule); `weight.grad` set,
  `main_grad` not written; `gradient_accumulation_fusion` true vs false 0 differ.

**Run log.** The line of Check.

## 9. Open points

1. The test uses a 201,088 × 2880 weight (Firmus test script `k2_3_lmhead.py` L9, `KT_LMHEAD_V`, available on
   request), not the model's 128,256 × 2880. The token count is the training one. The relative errors are not expected to depend on the vocab
   size, but the test is not at the exact training shape.
2. Assumption (a): the accumulation of the returned BF16 `dw` by Megatron's DDP hook (Megatron-LM `f6c33bde`) was
   not checked against the source or tested; state-dict keys are not covered by the test (parameter list and weight
   identity are).
